test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only five people sit to the left of M. J sits third to the left of O. O is not an immediate neighbour of M. K sits to the immediate right of N. I sits fourth to the right of J. Who sits at the extreme right end of the row?
solution:
Seven people **I, J, K, L, M, N and O**, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north.

1. Only five people sit to the left of M.

2. O is not an immediate neighbour of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f32b017c641ec93eb37c018eeeecaadc1d19cb90e784dd173bbd1ed04bd6f3.png] 

 

3. I sits fourth to the right of J.

**Case I:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2ea543ccafa5885eda380335f5959f16d959d2932f38b336cea9226cd9487f.png] 

Case II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70dd7b6e92fbe77f03755d9a90059a4e22e5208ebe3e4c3ba62490a16635ba21.png] 

4. J sits third to the left of O.

The above statement is violated in Case II, so it is eliminated.

5. K sits to the immediate right of N.** **

**Case I:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/532093a9a0d787df51c637554fb89981438469af4ae0eb79ff702894c2f31c5a.png] 

L, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

Case I:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3877f26afbce762db9aad8ae74a148b6b1f31d4ba8882e7f4a494aeb1c47772e.png] 

Clearly, L sits at the extreme right end of the row.

Hence, '**L**' is the correct answer.
